proof_scope: grahama.co update cascade guard for README/RESUME site surfaces, resume exports, llms.txt, ops-linkedin handoff planning, Calendly static public surfaces, and no-OS-protocol email behavior

claims.proves: the monitor-website update entrypoint exposes a one-command cascade plan for site, resume PDF/DOCX/Markdown/llms.txt, and LinkedIn profile handoff JSON while preserving ops-linkedin's NOT_EXECUTED platform boundary; the production static build still emits a real /resume.docx download linked from /resume and llms.txt; static Calendly booking actions render from public metadata without an inline auto-embed or exported PAT; site and resume email controls render as in-page copy buttons, not mailto links that can open an OS application chooser
claims.does_not_prove: live GitHub Pages deployment, formal design certification, actual LinkedIn platform mutation, broad disclosure-map health, ATS semantic parse quality, Calendly booking completion, or Calendly API availability in CI

cases.name: resume-docx-static-build-readback
command:
repo=$(git -C .. rev-parse --show-toplevel) && cd "$repo" && python3 site/scripts/gen_resume.py >/dev/null && (cd site && npm run build >/tmp/monitor-website-agentic-build.log) && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
html = Path('site/out/resume.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
resume = json.loads(Path('site/resume.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
llms = Path('site/public/llms.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
docx = Path('site/out/resume.docx')
assert 'data-qid="resume:link:docx"' in html
assert '/resume.docx' in html
assert resume['downloads']['docx'] == '/resume.docx'
assert 'https://grahama.co/resume.docx' in llms
assert docx.is_file() and docx.stat().st_size > 2000
assert zipfile.is_zipfile(docx)
with zipfile.ZipFile(docx) as z:
    assert 'word/document.xml' in z.namelist()
print('DOCX_SURFACE_OK')
PY

cases.name: calendly-static-build-readback
command:
repo=$(git -C .. rev-parse --show-toplevel) && cd "$repo" && export MONITOR_WEBSITE_SECRET_CANARY=monitor-website-secret-canary && env -u CALENDLY_PAT python3 site/scripts/gen_calendly.py >/tmp/monitor-website-calendly-gen.log && (cd site && npm run build >/tmp/monitor-website-calendly-build.log) && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re
from pathlib import Path
home = Path('site/out/index.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
resume = Path('site/out/resume.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
search_src = Path('site/components/capability-search.tsx').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
calendly = json.loads(Path('site/calendly.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert calendly['primarySchedulingUrl'] == 'https://calendly.com/graham-grahama/30min'
assert 'data-qid="contact:action:calendly"' in home
assert 'data-qid="contact:calendly:inline"' not in home
assert 'https://calendly.com/graham-grahama/30min' in home
assert 'data-qid="resume:link:calendly"' in resume
assert 'Book time' in resume
assert 'mailto:' not in home, 'homepage must not launch OS email protocol'
assert 'mailto:' not in resume, 'resume must not launch OS email protocol'
assert 'mailto:' not in search_src, 'search empty-state must not launch OS email protocol'
assert 'qid="search:empty:email"' in search_src
assert 'SEARCH_EMPTY_COPY_EMAIL' in search_src
nav_email = re.search(r'<(a|button)[^>]*data-qid="nav:link:email"[^>]*>', home)
assert nav_email, 'missing top-nav email control'
nav_email_tag = nav_email.group(0)
assert nav_email_tag.startswith('<button'), nav_email_tag
assert 'href=' not in nav_email_tag, nav_email_tag
assert 'NAV_COPY_EMAIL' in nav_email_tag, nav_email_tag
for qid, action in {
    'contact:action:email': 'CONTACT_COPY_EMAIL',
    'footer:link:email': 'FOOTER_COPY_EMAIL',
}.items():
    control = re.search(r'<(a|button)[^>]*data-qid="' + re.escape(qid) + r'"[^>]*>', home)
    assert control, f'missing {qid}'
    tag = control.group(0)
    assert tag.startswith('<button'), tag
    assert 'href=' not in tag, tag
    assert action in tag, tag
for path in Path('site/out').rglob('*'):
    if path.is_file() and path.suffix in {'.html', '.js', '.json', '.txt'}:
        text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore')
        assert 'monitor-website-secret-canary' not in text
print('CALENDLY_SURFACE_OK')
PY
